post.text:
A 62 year old Chinese man tests the limits of qinggong (轻功), a martial arts technique often described as the ability to fly or move with extreme lightness.
https://t.co/O6gEiDuqLl
post.author_description: Engineer. Selecting and curating pictures and videos trying to awaken your sense of wonder since 2014. Science, tech, art, weather, space, the unusual around us

description.description: A series of frames showing an individual performing various acrobatic and athletic stunts in different outdoor settings. In the first frame, he is crouched on the edge of a body of water in a park, about to leap. The second frame shows him mid-air jumping across a stone bridge over water. In the third frame, he is captured in a high jump between two towers made of plastic stools in an alleyway. The final frame shows him performing a precise jump over a stack of wooden benches to lightly touch the surface of water in a small basin.
